title: SPAN-Nav: Generalized Spatial Awareness for Versatile Embodied Navigation
selection_reason: SPAN-Nav compresses scene information into a compact spatial representation with one token per essential cue to mitigate computational burden, directly reducing the representation cost of vision-language navigation.
